⬥ This guides aims to get you started on doing Barrows runs, and will focus on the original six brothers.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It will be assumed that you're using Magic
⬥ War's Retreat is used for easy access to the Barrows Brothers
is unlocked via getting 10 boss kills (any boss).
⬥ Using High Contrast Mode lets you see which door is clickable when in the tunnels.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Right-click the World Map to toggle it on.
⬥ The mid-level preset and example video can be used as a reference if you're interested in killing Akrisae and Linza.

⬥ The following allow you to increase the efficiency of your runs:
    • Although useful, they are

• Increases damage and accuracy by 20% when fighting undead monsters.
⬥

• Increases damage done against ghosts related creatures by 10% when three or more pieces are worn.
⬥
will increase the speed of your runs.

⬥ As this is an older encounter, there aren't many mechanics to be wary of.
    • Each brother has a mechanic, which can mostly be ignored.
        ⬩ Dharok increases his damage dealt, the lower his life points get.
    • Being underground will periodically drain your prayer points.
    • The catacombs are a maze, with a simple puzzle at the end.

⬥ Searching one of the sarcophagi will place you in a random corner of the catacombs.
    • This sarcophagus is random, and normally reserved for last.
⬥ The catacombs are composed of a series of tunnels, in the shape of a 3x3 grid, with a treasure room in the center.
    • The path to the center is randomly generated.
    • Using High Contrast Mode makes finding the correct path easier.
⬥ The door leading to the center of the catacombs will have one of four,
, which always have the same solution.
Order the Brothers Should be Killed
Dharok → Ahrim → Karil → Guthan → Torag → Verac
⬥ You can use protection prayers to mitigate damage.
on Dharok, Guthan, Torag, and Verac.
⬥ Try to make good use of Surge
